title: Prompt Data Guard
summary: Before a message goes to an AI chat, says exactly what personal data, secrets or confidential documents are in it and where they'll go.
description: AI chat composer guard that says before send what goes where ("248 customer rows and a CONFIDENTIAL doc will go to OpenAI"), counting table rows, name columns, emails, phones, cards, Aadhaar, PAN and API keys in text and attachments, and can send with stand-ins.
catches: Pasted tables with personal data, counted by row
Names in name columns and their other mentions
Emails, phones, card numbers, Aadhaar and PAN
API keys and other secrets (via detectSecrets)
limits: Names in free text need your detectNames (an NER model or CRM list)
Destination and retention text come from your destination prop
Detection is pattern-based; it can miss data or flag harmless text
a11y: Visible label; textarea is described by the readback when risky
Remove-attachment buttons have aria-labels naming the file
Focus returns to the field after changes; animations are skipped under reduced motion
server: Apply DLP and redaction on the server or gateway before data reaches the model provider.
stops: Helps keep a customer list out of an AI chat
